title: Resolve the decorator cache field and replay four original histories
description: Retry the unmodifiable iterator experiment after JDI could not resolve the field type in the iterator loader at the first substitution. Resolve the existing bootstrap Boolean without initialization when needed on substituted JVMs, then require the same helper instruction, receiver and entire prestate. Compare two ordinary and two substituted continuations and four live negative controls per endpoint. Verify the throwing decorator and public catch and recheck both sets of finite certificates.
